invariants.rationale: The restore method returns the result of executing a restoration action, which should always produce non-null metadata on success.
The restoreInstantTimestamp is passed as a required parameter to the restore operation and used for restoring a specific instant.
The savepointToRestoreTimestamp is required for identifying the savepoint being restored.
The context is passed into the restoration logic and used in executor construction, so it must not be null.
